speaker: Leonard
text: I'm, I'm looking for, uh, Sheldon Cooper's apartment. What? Run fast, run far. That should have been my first clue.

speaker: Unknown_speaker006
text: Oh, I bet you're here to check out the room for rent. Run away, dude. Our whole universe was in a hot dense state, then nearly fourteen billion years ago, expansion started. Wait, the earth began to cool, the autotrophs began to drool, Neanderthals developed tools, we built a wall.

speaker: Unknown_speaker006
text: We built the pyramids, math, science, history, we unraveled in the mystery that all started with a big bang. Hey!

speaker: Leonard
text: For all I knew, he was the crazy one. He had this really deranged look.

speaker: Penny
text: So Sheldon's last roommate tried to warn you off? Well, yeah, he'd been living with Sheldon.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sure, it makes sense now. Anyway, I went upstairs and knocked on the door.
